counts: 12 null points*256 train + 60 candidate points*64 calibration groups*8 frames + 60*32 evaluation groups*8 frames = 49152
unknown_nuisance: same fixed public mu/tau/noise grid for every observation; truth only generator, calibration condition design and external scorer
null_calibration: maximum of finite-sample split calibration order statistics across all 12 null nuisance conditions; confidence sets similarly across all 60 true grid candidates
coverage_scope: marginal over independent calibration/evaluation at each discrete grid law, not conditional on realized calibration or off-grid continuous coverage
information_free_baseline: second Gaussian has no q/mu information; detection uses an independent alpha coin, q/center errors are unavailable, grid uncertainty retained
independence: each case has independent channel/data/noise groups; all methods share observations; R1 is first frame of same R8 group
teacher_fixed: score4 uses predeclared point1 phase model regardless of evaluation truth; no teacher selection on test
cost: candidate construction, teacher, training, calibration and complete inference recorded; detection/estimation/sets reuse objective matrices
